assumptions: 348 of 2968 search matches for 'pembrolizumab' were excluded because 'pembrolizumab' is not one of their drug interventions.
A link means both drugs are given in the same arm of at least 2 trials; drugs only listed in different arms of a trial (e.g. drug vs comparator) are not linked.
Network shows the top 25 drugs by number of trials with a same-arm combination; 1198 such drugs were found.
Drugs an arm offers as alternatives (its description reads e.g. 'cisplatin or carboplatin') are not a combination; arms without a description are taken as given together.
Supplements, placebo, saline and 'standard of care' are not counted as drugs.
408 drug pairs appear in an arm only as alternatives and are not counted as combinations.
7 trials list two or more drugs but do not record which arm receives them, so they cannot show a combination and are left out.
